event_detail: At 40-45 s the arm wanders above and beside the island with the gripper closed and empty. It does not open any drawer or approach the glass cup.
evidence: In both shoulder views the island drawer stack under the counter stays closed in all 4 moments: the handles are evenly aligned and the fronts flush. The gripper moves up and around (wrist view shows the countertop, the plant, then the floor and the wall) with nothing between the fingers. No straw is visible anywhere, and the cup by the plant is untouched.
